text.title: Rust Error Handling Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema for the error-design spec capturing crate type, error-library choice, and clippy gate config.

section.title: Spec schema

example.code: { "crate_type": "library", "error_library": "thiserror", "variants": [ {"name": "Io", "display": "I/O error", "from": "std::io::Error", "source": true}, {"name": "Parse", "display": "parse error: {0}", "from": "serde_json::Error", "source": true}, {"name": "NotFound", "display": "resource not found"} ], "clippy_gate": {"unwrap_used": "deny", "expect_used": "deny"}, "box_dyn_error_in_public_api": 0, "ci_gate_command": "bash scripts/check-errors.sh", "version": "1.0.0", "last_reviewed": "2026-05-22" }

example.note: Library crate must use thiserror, not anyhow. Clippy gate must be "deny" not "warn". Three public signatures still return Box<dyn Error>. Missing version + last_reviewed + ci_gate_command.

list.item: `Box<dyn Error>` in any public signature crossing a crate API boundary.
`anyhow::Result` returned from a published library function.
An error variant carrying its source as a `String` instead of `#[source]` / `#[from]`.
`clippy_gate` set to "warn" — a warning is not a gate.
A gate that exists only in prose, with no committed command CI actually runs.
